title: Department of Health and Human Services: Phase 56O Remediation Follow-Through
summary: GAO reports that HHS implemented four of thirty-five prior priority recommendations, added seven, and now has thirty-eight priority recommendations focused on program integrity and public-health oversight. Phase 56O decision: Publish the exact portfolio movement without treating it as clinical, provider, or preparedness performance.
key_findings: Exact record: GAO-26-108997 HHS priority recommendation portfolio.
Status period: May 2025 baseline through May 2026.
Continuation rule: Reopen when GAO publishes the next HHS priority letter, changes a named priority status, or HHS OIG posts the held hospital-control update.
why_it_matters: The record exposes implementation throughput and remaining remediation workload without converting a portfolio into a performance rate.
ftfn_relevance: Keeps implemented, added, de-prioritized, current, modeled, and realized states distinct.
Attaches source, period, scope, limitation, remaining gap, and continuation rule.
evidence_limits: The letter aggregates multiple health-program recommendations. Portfolio movement is not a clinical outcome, provider result, preparedness score, or substitute for the held hospital-control tracker record.
Action-level closure evidence for the thirty-eight priorities, the open AI-inventory action, and a post-July 29 public update for the four held hospital-control recommendations.
No ranking, composite, readiness score, performance rate, or causal claim is supported.
